$comment: Extensible machine-readable catalog of Private App hosting guides. Coding agents and developers: read this file and list subdirectories of apps/private/hosting/ to discover runtime-specific deployment instructions. New providers are added here and in apps/private/hosting/<slug>/ without modifying core contract files.
